pkgmetadata.longdescription: Rust Token Killer: a command-line proxy that filters and compresses command output before it reaches an LLM agent's context. The engine USE flag builds the full edition with the BUSL-1.1 compression engine; without it only the Apache-2.0 hook and filter core is built.

use.flag: Build the full edition, linking the BUSL-1.1 rtk-engine compression engine (upstream's default); without it, the Apache-2.0 "OSS" edition with the hook rewrite system and command filters
